lines.369680624067883008: Why did you turn back? I don’t understand…
lines.369680624067883010: Everything was going to be great for us. I had it all figured out. We’d escape together, no one would ever find us.
lines.369680624067883012: I fucked up. It’s over. There’s no point anymore.
lines.369680624072077313: Look at you. Look what I did to you. You told me but I didn’t listen. I never listen. It was never the town, it was me.
lines.369680624076271616: I was the worst thing that could have happened to you. I’m the nightmare.
lines.369680624076271617: I’m done. Please make it stop. I just want this to stop.
lines.369680624076271618: I want this to be over.
lines.369680624076271619: What did you do, Eddie? Did you kill the girl?
lines.369680624080465920: You would still be alive if you hadn't met me.
lines.369680624080465923: I want it to be over.
lines.369680624109826048: Sorry Eddie. There was no other way...
lines.369680624193712128: It's just rain, we've heard all this before!
lines.369680624193712129: If the levees fail then it'll be even worse than back in '44!
lines.369680624193712130: What about the Baker girl, she's still missing. Why was the search called off?
lines.369680624193712131: We don't need to search! It's that damn musician! Look at him!
lines.369680624193712132: I already told the sheriff I had nothing to do with that. Fuck you!
lines.369680624193712133: Is she up there? Did you hide her up on the peak? Just tell us where the she is!
lines.369680624202100736: Surprised to see anyone still outside. Most people are holed up somewhere high and dry or they’ve skipped town.
lines.369680624202100737: So I keep hearing. I’m looking for a musician called Eddie Velvet.
lines.369680624202100738: Don’t know him. But he must be someone very important to you, to be braving this kind of weather.
lines.369680624202100739: Well, it’s my job. I find people.
lines.369680624202100740: Even if the people you’re looking for don’t want to be found?
lines.369680624202100741: Sorry, don’t mean to stick my nose where it doesn’t belong.
lines.369680624210489344: I’m sure you have very good reasons to be doing what you’re doing.
lines.369680624210489345: Is there a cable car service here in town?
lines.369680624210489346: You planning on sight seeing? It's just north of here.
lines.369680624210489347: It won't be easy getting there with so much of the town being closed off. But if it's important enough to you, I'm sure you'll manage.
lines.369680624214683648: The cable car station is just north from here.
lines.369680624214683649: Hope you find what you're looking for.
lines.369680624223072256: I hear the storm's getting worse. Water is rising, the road's been eaten away.
lines.369680624223072257: I wasn't leaving anyway. Not until I find Eddie.
lines.369680624223072258: What is he to you anyway? If you're just chasing a paycheck there must be easier ways. Did he do something to you?
lines.369680624227266560: No, no... It's more than that.
lines.369680624231460864: I don't know how to say it.
